description: Create a bathroom renovation price comparison spreadsheet. Open /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/bathroom_renovation_comparison.xlsx. Create headers in row 1: 'Material' (A1), 'Home Depot' (B1), 'Lowe's' (C1), 'Builder's Best' (D1). In column A (rows 2-6), enter materials: Toilet, Vanity Sink, Faucet, Tile (per box), Grout. Enter prices for Home Depot (column B): 189.99, 245.00, 78.50, 35.99, 22.49. Enter prices for Lowe's (column C): 199.99, 229.99, 72.99, 38.50, 19.99. Enter prices for Builder's Best (column D): 179.99, 259.00, 75.00, 33.99, 21.50. In A7 type 'TOTAL'. Create SUM formulas: B7: =SUM(B2:B6), C7: =SUM(C2:C6), D7: =SUM(D2:D6). Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
